title: Zesty Briny Ethiopian Chicken Dulet
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish with a twist, featuring chicken stock concentrate and yakimono-grill flavors, this recipe is ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly and perfect for a midnight craving.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together chicken stock concentrate, berbere spice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced onion to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Grill the onion slices for 3-4 minutes per side, or until caramelized.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Brush the yakimono grill sauce on the chicken during the last minute of cooking.
Serve the chicken with the grilled onion and sauce spooned over the top.
